# OMLMO Home & Kitchen Wholesale

OMLMO Home & Kitchen Wholesale is a B2B online wholesale showroom based in Yiwu, China. The website focuses on kitchen gadgets, storage and organization, cleaning tools, bathroom accessories and home lifestyle gifts.

## Buyer types
Importers, distributors, supermarket buyers, Amazon sellers, Shopify sellers, home goods retailers and promotional product buyers.

## Product categories
- Kitchen Gadgets
- Storage & Organization
- Cleaning Tools
- Bathroom Accessories
- Home Lifestyle Gifts

## Trade terms
MOQ usually starts from 500 pcs per SKU. Mixed orders, samples, custom logo and custom packaging are available depending on product and supplier.
